ayahOccurrences.text: وَقَالَ نِسْوَةٌ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ تُرَٰوِدُ فَتَىٰهَا عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۖ قَدْ شَغَفَهَا حُبًّا ۖ إِنَّا لَنَرَىٰهَا فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَقَالَ نِسْوَةٌ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ تُرَٰوِدُ فَتَىٰهَا عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۖ قَدْ شَغَفَهَا حُبًّا ۖ إِنَّا لَنَرَىٰهَا فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: شَغَفَهَا is in the derivative form: شَغَفَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ش/غ/ف   sh–gh–f the membrane enclosing the heart (the pericardium); the centre; to smite, to pierce; to infatuate, to be smitten with love, ardent love, passion. Of this root, only شَغَفَ shaghafa occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
شَغَفَ shaghafa a [v. trans.] to penetrate the innermost part [of the heart], to smite

(12:30) امْرَأَةُ الْعَزِيزِ تُرَاوِدُ فَتَاهَا عَنْ نَفْسِهِ قَدْ شَغَفَهَا حُبًّا the governor’s wife is trying to seduce her slave!, he has smitten her heart with love [lit. penetrated the core of her heart].
